494

Called Meeting City Council
Austin, Texas April 17 18-78
Mayor Di Grass presiding.
Roll called. Present Aldermen
Brooker, Millett, Metz, Havens and
Vaughans.
There being no quorum present Alderman
Millett moved a call of the council.
Call sustained and the Marshall sent
for the absentees. Alderman Platt
and Strong appeared and answered to
their names.
There being a quorum present on motion
of Alderman Millett the roll was
suspended.
His Honor the Mayor then presented
a certified copy of a petition of the
City Water Company to Hon. C. B. Carner
Judge 16th Judicial District and
also a citation to appear and answer
and asked the action of the council in
the premises.
The petition and citation were read
Alderman Millett moved that the
Council go into secret session.
Carried.
Open session resumed
Alderman Platt moved that a committee of
to consist of the Mayor & two Aldermen
be appointed to employ competent
counsel to defend the City in the suit with the City Water Company. The motion was
carried and Aldermen Platt & Millett
were appointed members of the committee.
It was unanimously agreed by the members
of the Council present that the committee should be authorized to use their discretion in
fixing the fee to be paid to the counsel so to be employed.

On motion of Alderman
Brooker the Council adjourned.
Approved. L. M. Bradley
May 14 1878 City Clerk
